detail.longDescription: 🐧 SIGINT // Linux Watch — 2026-11-22 A critical Java flaw has Ubuntu shipping fixed OpenJDK 17, 21, and 25 builds across 22.04 through 26.10. If you self-host anything on the JVM, patch first and then find out how many JVMs you were actually running. 🔗 https:// about.gitlab.com/blog/java4she ll-critical-java-flaw-how-gitlab-helps/ # Linux # OpenSource # FOSS
